notes: the table of all genes has 294 subcolumns (one per biological unit of the largest group): it needs Prism 9 or later (Prism 6 to 8 allow 256); the Column tables open in any version
launch_note: Prism is not installed on this computer: download the bundle and double-click the project file on the computer that has Prism

open_steps.label: macOS
steps: Unzip the bundle: double-click the zip. (Skip this when Prism runs on this computer: the folder is already here.)
Double-click qpilot_ea8208bcd21d.pzfx. GraphPad Prism opens it (or in Prism: File > Open). If another program opens it, Control-click it and choose Open With > GraphPad Prism.

open_steps.label: Windows
steps: Unzip the bundle: right-click the zip and choose Extract All. (Skip this when Prism runs on this computer: the folder is already here.)
Double-click qpilot_ea8208bcd21d.pzfx. GraphPad Prism opens it (or in Prism: File > Open). If another program opens it, right-click it and choose Open with > GraphPad Prism.

analyse_steps: In Prism, click a gene's table under Data Tables (one table per gene).
The test: click Analyze, choose 't tests (and nonparametric tests)', OK. Choose Unpaired, Parametric and Welch's correction (do not assume equal SDs), then OK.
The graph: click New Graph, choose the scatter plot of individual values with 'Mean with 95% CI', then OK.
round_trip_steps: Leave a value out in Prism with Edit > Exclude (the value shows in blue italics with an asterisk), or change it.
Save the project: File > Save. If Prism asks for a format, keep Prism XML (.pzfx).
In qPilot, open Prism > Round trip and choose the saved project file. Each exclusion or change comes back as a question, with what it does to the conclusions.
